closure_enforcer: cannot-automate: Qor-logic enters its maintenance freeze in this very phase, so no later plan or audit exists for a skill or gate change to guard; the pattern is recorded in SHADOW_GENOME Entry #46 and is applied here by narrowing the Phase 304 LD-2 contract, which the re-audit verifies.

proposed_changes.change: Shrink the freeze_check contract instead of enumerating it further. The normative contract becomes a regression contract over this repository's own files: on an unmodified copy and on this repository check returns []; each of five named regressions (the pre-freeze Beta classifier, a committed dependabot config, the pre-freeze nightly schedule, the README freeze section removed, the AGENTS freeze section removed), applied one at a time to a copy, makes check return a non-empty list whose every violation names the regressed file; main exits 0/1 and ends with the summary line. Parsing details (YAML key forms, heading matching, section boundaries, ordering) are declared non-normative implementation detail.
proposed_changes.rationale: Three consecutive coverage-gap VETOs (META_LEDGER #841-#843; SHADOW_GENOME #44-#46, signature d3d29c40b9855932) each found surviving mutants in a wider clause list: 2 rules, then 3, then 7 after 23 atomic clauses were tested. Each iteration widened the specification of a general-purpose checker and the clause surface grew faster than the tests. The deliverable needs only to detect the regressions that would undo the freeze; specifying exactly that gives a finite contract a mutation review can close.

proposed_changes.change: No process change. The three research-phase overrides are one owner decision (no research phase for the freeze) re-recorded per plan iteration; the third carries the friction justification. They end with this phase.
proposed_changes.rationale: The overrides are iteration count, not drift: same reason, same authority, one per plan iteration.

proposed_changes.change: No process change. codex-plugin and external-reviewer are absent from this host; each audit used a fresh-context Option B subagent reviewer instead, which the risk score required anyway.
proposed_changes.rationale: An unchanging host property recorded once per audit run; the independent-review requirement was met by Option B.
